entities.summary: David Quinn is an American professional ice hockey coach and former player who is the assistant coach for the New York Rangers of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was previously the head coach of the Rangers and San Jose Sharks of the NHL, the Lake Erie Monsters of the American Hockey League (AHL), assistant coach for the Colorado Avalanche of the NHL, and head coach at Boston University. He was formally inducted into the Rhode Island Hockey Hall of Fame in 2021.
